descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Description: Throughout our 125-year history, Roche has grown into one of the world’s largest biotech companies and a global supplier of transformative innovative solutions across major disease areas. At Roche, we believe every employee makes a difference. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are confident in both decision and action, we believe that good business means a better world. We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology . In Roche Digital Technology, we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives. You will be responsible for the Consolidation and Management of the solutions intended for Identity Verification and External Collaborator Management, you will design, build, and deliver next-generation solutions that operate at a global scale You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives. Your team: As a Specialist External Workforce Identity, you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks. Your key responsibilities:
• Contribute to the end to end integration of the External Collaborators Management and the Identity Verification security solutions, producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.
• Identify Verification: Partner with Product owners from P&C and act as a core member driving the ID Verification product offering, leading initiatives to upgrade secure access controls for modern enterprises
• External Collaborators Management: Partner with Business owners and act as point of contact to understand their requirements and translate them into technical requirements and implementation steps
• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and coordinate the Security Components migration from the acquired company to Roche Standards.
• Design and maintain the mid-term strategy for enhancing our security components..
• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implementing changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction
• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management
• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve
• Occasional international travel is required Required skills and experience:
• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.
• 5-7 years of experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry and in providing solutions aligned with standards, security, validation, capacity and high availability.
• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures
• Strong hands-on technical skills with an IT operations background. Knowledge on infrastructure
